title: Steam AI games publishing
author: Legitimate_Oil6245
selftext:
Hello, I'd like to ask the community the following:  
Is it safe to publish your game on steam declaring its using AI if you use stuff like Stable Diffusion or Midjourney? 

Do you have to provide your training images source as a dev or you can just assume liability for your art and don't get questioned further?  
If your AI art is edited and does not give that classic AI look would they even know if you straight up do not mention your game uses AI?

Did someone try publishing since Steam turned off the AI ban?

comments.author: AmpedHorizon
comments.body: Hi, I don't think it's a problem, and you just have to do a mandatory survey where you have to declare that you've used generative AI (checkbox).

replies.author: Legitimate_Oil6245
replies.body: This is how I imagined it would be, tx.

comments.author: Financial-Drummer825
comments.body: Upload your game for review before you start to guide people to wishlist your game. It took me a month on review and then Steam just banned my AI game with no reason.

replies.author: AmpedHorizon
replies.body: Strange, the store is full of games with AI generated images. Did your game use live generated AI content?

replies.author: Financial-Drummer825
replies.body: Yes. We allow user to generate characters while playing.

replies.author: Legitimate_Oil6245
replies.body: It's hard or impossible to predict what the AI will generate during gameplay, so this might be the reason

comments.author: janejinjin
comments.body: I've noticed several studios have released AI-powered games recently. It might be worth reaching out to the Steam team about this trend.

comments.author: LinaCrystaa
comments.body: What's ur game id like to check it out when it's out

comments.author: Lunalierose
comments.body:
If you’re interested in how to disclose AI use on Steam, there’s a new game coming out soon called \*Retail Mage\* that uses generative AI in a pretty cool way. Even though I’m not the dev, I know they’ve included a little notice at the bottom of their Steam page about how they use GenAI to stay transparent and in line with Steam’s policies. Might be worth a look if you want an example of how to package your game for Steam—especially for navigating their recent AI guidelines!

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/3224380/Retail\_Mage/?beta=1](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3224380/Retail_Mage/?beta=1)

replies.author: Legitimate_Oil6245
replies.body: This is interesting, tx. I wonder if they chose to include that notice or it's a steam requirement.
